description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the EvaluateCertificateQuality operation in the image recognition (imagerecog) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像识别（imagerecog）类目下的证件照质量审核EvaluateCertificateQuality的语法及示例
name: EvaluateCertificateQuality

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. Use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

IDCard: ID card.
BusinessLicense: Electronic business license
parameters.help_zh:
证照类型。

IDCard：身份证。
BusinessLicense：电子执照
parameters.name: type

Elements.description_en: The list of identified quality issues
Elements.description_zh: 输出识别出的质量问题列表

Pass.description_en:
Specifies whether the check is passed. Valid values:

true: The check is passed.
false: The check is not passed.
verify: The certificate quality cannot be verified. Manual confirmation is required.
ERROR: Algorithm inference failed for this module
Pass.description_zh:
是否通过检查。

true：通过检查。
false：未通过检查。
verify：无法检验证照质量，请人工确认。
ERROR：该模块算法推理失败

Score.description_en:
The quality issue score. A higher score indicates a more severe issue. Valid values: integers from 0 to 100.

If the system cannot provide a score, the output is score.
If the Pass field is ERROR, the output is null
Score.description_zh:
质量问题分值，分值越高，问题越严重，取值为0~100之间的整数。

当系统无法给出分值时，输出结果为`score`。
当Pass字段为`ERROR`时，输出结果为`null`

Value.description_en:
The issue type. Valid values:

lackoffront: missing front photo.
copy: photocopy.
imageincomplete: incomplete certificate image.
nationalemblemincomplete: incomplete national emblem on the business license.
lackofseal: missing seal.
electronic: originating from an electronic file.
reflection: reflection.

If the Type request parameter is set to IDCard, lackofseal (missing seal) is not returned.
If the Type request parameter is set to BusinessLicense, lackoffront (missing front photo) is not returned
Value.description_zh:
问题类型。

lackoffront： 缺乏正面照。
copy：复印件。
imageincomplete：证件图像不完整。
nationalemblemincomplete：营业执照国徽不完整。
lackofseal：缺乏印章。
electronic：来源于电子档。
reflection：反光。

如果请求参数Type为IDCard，无lackofseal（缺乏印章）。
如果请求参数Type为BusinessLicense，无lackoffront（缺乏正面照）
